messages:
Maria (CS): Heads-up — Seastone onboarding: 95thpct tail latency spiked ~320ms vs baseline since yesterday. Contexts trending ~1.8k tokens. I want to propose a proactive perf plan: INT8 quant variant + route latency-sensitive requests to compact-v2, keep default on standard-v1. Renewal flagged as 'watch' so fixing this helps retention. Thoughts?
AJ (Eng): Can you paste the metric window and a sample request rate? also what's their SLA target?
Maria (CS): SLA target is 200ms p95. Quick metrics: `p95: 520ms -> baseline 200ms`, `p50: 80ms`, error rate stable. Traffic: 120 req/s peak, 10% long-context (>1k).
Devin (ML): Relevant context — compact-v2 INT8 typically saves ~1.8-2x cost and cuts GPU time for long context, but expect ~8-12% delta in certain instruction-following turns. My plan: (1) generate 150-example eval set from Seastone, (2) run a quality diff for compact-v2 int8 vs standard-v1, (3) propose 5% canary for 48h with automatic rollback on QA/regression or latency regressions. Also enable prefix KV caching for their common prompts.
Sana (Platform): We can implement routing policy in Console: route where `user_latency_requirement == low` -> standard-v1 pool; else fallback to compact-v2. I can create a canary policy: 5% traffic -> compact-v2-int8, 95% -> standard, with health checks (p95, error rate). Need the model artifact tag and the S3 path for the quantized artifact.
deploy-bot: scheduled-canary-ops: will attempt to schedule a canary window per requested UTC window, respond with confirmation once SLA checks pass.
Maria (CS): I'll message Seastone for the eval prompts and confirm willingness for 5% canary. Also capture customer sentiment (quick NPS-style Q to their PM) after 48h.
Devin (ML): Quick config suggestion: batching min=1, max=8, kv_cache_ttl=300s, and enable dynamic quantization fallback for the first 2k tokens. Small snippet for eval runner I will use: ```python
EVAL_PROMPTS = load_from_csv('seastone_eval.csv')
results = compare_models(EVAL_PROMPTS, ['standard-v1', 'compact-v2-int8'])
print(summarize_diff(results, metrics=['exact_match','bleurt','latency']))
```
AJ (Eng): Ops can do the canary tonight at 02:00 UTC. I will hook up alerts: p95 > 220ms for 10m -> rollback; error rate +2% -> rollback. I'll monitor logs and perf dashboards.
Sana (Platform): I'll create the route rule and post the Console JSON for review once I have the artifact path. Expect a config like: ```json
{"policy": "canary-v1", "routes": [{"weight":95, "model":"standard-v1"}, {"weight":5, "model":"compact-v2-int8"}], "health_checks": {"p95_ms":220, "error_increase_pct":2}}
```
Maria (CS): Action items: Maria -> message Seastone + collect 150 eval prompts; Devin -> run eval + post diff; Sana -> prepare model artifact + canary rule; AJ -> schedule canary & monitoring; deploy-bot -> confirm schedule. Tagging: @Devin (ML) @Sana (Platform) @AJ (Eng). :thumbsup:
AJ (Eng): lgtm, ping me when eval is in.
Devin (ML): on it, will post results in this thread when done.
Maria (CS): Thanks team — will update customer and push for opt-in.
